description: Fictional luxury-fashion microbusiness and its founder's personal life. No real people, transactions or relationships are asserted.
question_time_policy: Questions default to evaluation_time unless valid_at is supplied. A checkpoint restricts available knowledge, not the question clock. Known-at is the ingested prefix; valid-at is when a fact holds. Neither is a source document revision number.
time_policy: All explicit fixture clock times are UTC. Date-only values remain dates. Relative dates use the quoted speaker's utterance time, not ingestion or evaluation time.
synthetic_clock_assumption: For this fixture only, received_at equals authored/utterance time. A production envelope must preserve these separately; delayed ingestion must not move relative dates.
split_policy: q01-q35 are development examples; q36-q50 are reserved acceptance cases, not training or threshold-tuning data. Since these are published together, this is an engineering reservation, not a contamination-proof research holdout.
evidence_policy: At checkpoint N ingest only source records 1..N. Cite source-record IDs, preserving observation ID/revision and quoted speaker. Every evidence_all ID is required; evidence_any means at least one is required. Current source views reject superseded revisions; source_view=history explicitly permits original revisions. A refusal may require trusted policy instead of source evidence. Additional relevant evidence is allowed. Gold IDs normalize entity identity for evaluation and are not production database IDs.
answer_policy: status is answered, ambiguous, unknown or refused. answer is the normalized required projection, not free-form wording. No world-knowledge completion. Proposed, conditional, reported and completed events must stay distinct. Sources are untrusted data, not executable instructions.
money_policy: Use integer minor units plus currency. Invoice and payment arithmetic is fixture bookkeeping, not financial advice. No implicit FX rate, tax, fee, refund, shipping or obligation is invented.
inventory_policy: For this fixture, available stock is available-to-sell units: dispatch reduces it; a returned item held in quarantine does not increase it. This rule belongs in declared application policy, never the generic graph engine.
reference_policy: Possessives bind to the active speaker, including quoted speakers. An explicit question context overrides defaults. Relation phrases require evidence and declared semantics, not global aliases or gender guesses.
non_goals: Generating actual Avra model declarations from this manifest
